structure.source: NIST CCCBDB experimental geometry, reference 1986Dar/Ger (r O–H 0.973 Å, r O–Cl 1.697 Å, re values; angle H–O–Cl 102.45°)

notes.title: Construction without symmetry
notes.text: With no symmetry group to pair atoms, the construction slider switches on every coupling to oxygen in one step.

notes.title: Inequivalent terminal atoms
notes.text: H and Cl are different, so fix-and-flip pairing does not apply: there is no equal-energy pair to combine.
